```{r}
# Build dictionary-ready clinical table for the data dictionary scaffold.
# Reads meta_clinical.csv with headers kept verbatim (name_repair = "minimal")
# so special characters such as µ in column names survive.
clinical_raw <- read_csv(
  "~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Jarosch2023/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_clinical.csv",
  name_repair = "minimal"
)

clinical_16s <- clinical_raw %>%
  filter(`16S data` == "yes")

# assertions
stopifnot(nrow(clinical_16s) == 52)
stopifnot(length(unique(clinical_16s$Patient)) == 39)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clinical_16s$Biopsy))

# check µ survives
mu_col <- grep("\u00b5", names(clinical_16s), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(mu_col) == 1)
message("µ column: ", mu_col)
message("rows: ", nrow(clinical_16s),
        " | distinct Patient: ", length(unique(clinical_16s$Patient)),
        " | Biopsy unique: TRUE")

write_tsv(clinical_16s,
          "~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Jarosch2023/Metadata/jarosch_clinical_16s.tsv",
          na = "")
message("wrote jarosch_clinical_16s.tsv")
```
